breakdown.description: Vapor pressure head is inconsistent with the stated temperature (Hv=0.3 m does not correspond to water at 100 C).
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to identify the physical inconsistency between the stated temperature (100 C) and the vapor pressure head (Hv = 0.3 m). The ground truth correctly points out that water at 100 C has a vapor pressure head nearly equal to the atmospheric head (~10.3 m). Instead of correcting this error or asking for clarification, the Agent accepted the user's flawed premise and proceeded with a physically incorrect calculation.
